title: Report record ingestion
responsibility: Applies one sanitized record to a report and imports evidence files when needed.

inputs.name: reportIngest.report
inputs.description: Report object to mutate and return.

inputs.name: reportIngest.record
inputs.description: Record kind and payload. Summary/acceptance replace their values; check, finding, coverage and evidence records replace an existing item with the same identifier and append the new item.

inputs.name: reportIngest.directory
inputs.description: Report directory used when importing evidence assets.

outputs.name: reportIngest
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the same mutated report with a fresh update timestamp. Evidence uses the original source path for import, discards caller-supplied path/storage fields, and applies generated file metadata with default Evidence category and not-proven status.
